S1.command: cc "Extract event, date, venue and fee as JSON from: $(cat structured/notice.txt)" | jq -r .result | node structured/plain.mjs
S1.result: The model wraps the JSON in a ```json fence. JSON.parse throws: Unexpected token '`'. The date field holds extra text and the fee is a nested object.

S2.command: jq -c '.properties | map_values(.type)' structured/schema.json ; cc "Extract ..." --json-schema "$(cat structured/schema.json)" | jq .structured_output
S2.result: The model returns exactly 4 fields: event, date 2026-10-24, venue, fee 500 as a number.

S3.result: typeof fee is number. fee + 100 is 600. new Date(date) is Saturday, 24 October 2026.
